title: Permutation equivariance of biased monomials
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, $p\in(0,1)$, $\sigma$ a permutation of the $n$ coordinates, $S$ a subset of coordinates, and $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. The biased monomial indexed by $S$, evaluated on the input with coordinates permuted by $\sigma$, equals the biased monomial indexed by $\sigma(S)$ evaluated at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $\sigma$ is a permutation of the coordinates
$S$ is a subset of the coordinates
